name: Band Standing Crunch
steps: Anchor a resistance band high, stand facing away with feet hip-width apart and knees soft, and hold the ends beside your temples.
Brace your core tightly and fix your hips in place.
Exhale and curl your rib cage smoothly downward toward your pelvis against the band's pull.
Uncurl slowly back to upright without letting the band pull your torso backward.
tips: Keep your hips still so your abs flex your spine rather than hinging forward at the waist.
Keep your hands fixed beside your temples instead of pulling the band down with your arms.
